MegaBlast Mayhem

A colorful local multiplayer bomb-arena game set in Verdantia. Up to four players battle friends or bots, collect powerups, and conquer the Region Tour.

Padmara Expansion

The first major expansion introduces a region inspired by India’s architecture, gardens, waterways, and festivals, with a new Region Tour and new competitors.
